designation_ruling.justification: STGQ-Modular comprises 256,236 parameters across graph diffusion and mixture-of-experts blocks, whereas the single-turbine MLP contains 4,865 parameters (a ~53x parameter ratio). Because the single-turbine MLP was sized to match the capacity of a single-turbine local feedforward block rather than the full multi-node spatio-temporal graph system, it functions as an architectural lesion control (severing spatial graph interactions) rather than an identical-capacity or FLOPs-matched model. The scientific claim ceiling must formally designate it as a No-Graph Architectural Control.
